applies_to: E01 masters and derived states (and every future character/prop)
unchanged: manual art_outbox export → export-gpt-job route (never submit)
evaluation identity: a rule change mints a new generation; approvals bind ruleset version P08.0
characters: face_composition: ownership of BASE_HEAD / BROWS / EYES / MOUTH regions by named channels (schema motion_art_manifest_v2 rig.face_composition)
MOUTH channel states carry face {family, viseme (EN_ARPABET_VISEME_V1), view_id}; only the tuples the phase's measured phones and expression timeline USE are requested

EXPRESSION channel states carry face.family (and bundled_mouth when a cel bakes a mouth); approved within-channel edges list the D4 intermediates (mock-regal → grin; grin → slip → concern; concern → social smile with concerned eyes)
hands: separate NEAR thumb and FAR finger layer slots + reviewed patch sockets (thumb, finger, pinch point) for WRAP/PINCH; holding sockets declare basis_angle_deg (production contacts are oriented)
joints the directed poses bend: owned underpaint / hidden-surface paint (verified on alpha every frame)
legs only if D1 framing shows them; a walking route needs reviewed sole sockets + leg IK (or an approved gait cel cycle)
props: registered grip/edge sockets with basis; the phone's LENS socket (PHOTO_INTENT forward axis)
a container/occluder needs separate front/aperture layers and registered inside/slot sockets
worlds: declared band depths when a dolly/orbit is directed; an orbit of a 2D world needs approved view/depth art beyond the approved flat-azimuth coverage
schemas_added_or_versioned: manifest: channel state face{}, channel edges[], rig face_composition
